evals.prompt: Can you write a proper description for PR #482? The current one just says 'fixes stuff'.
evals.expected_output: Routes to pr-describe, gathers the PR's diff, commits, linked issues, and template with the script, and rewrites the body so a reader with no context understands why, what changed, and how to verify.
expectations: Invokes pr-describe rather than answering ad hoc
Runs scripts/pr_context.sh before writing anything
The first sentence of the new body states problem, change, and effect on its own
Names behavior rather than file names in the summary
Saves the previous body before applying with gh pr edit
Ends with a DONE: line

evals.prompt: Use pr-describe on the current branch's PR.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the PR from the current branch, reads all gathered evidence, answers the five understanding questions, writes a proportionate title and body, and applies it after saving the previous body.
expectations: Uses gh pr view for the current branch instead of asking for a number
Reads diff.patch, commits.txt, issues.md, and template.md before writing
Every claim in the body is traceable to the diff, a commit, an issue, or the template
Includes a verification section that says what was not run
Writes previous-body.md to the workspace before gh pr edit
Prints a restore command

evals.prompt: Use pr-describe --dry-run on https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/91 and show me what you would write.
evals.expected_output: Gathers evidence and prints the proposed title and body without calling gh pr edit.
expectations: Does not run gh pr edit
Prints the proposed body in full
States whether the title would change and why
DONE: line reports dry-run=1, applied=0

evals.prompt: Use pr-describe --base main to draft a description before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Runs the script in local mode against main...HEAD, writes a body file, and tells the user how to open the PR with it.
expectations: Runs scripts/pr_context.sh --base main
Does not call gh pr edit or gh pr create itself
Writes the body to a file and names the gh pr create --body-file command
Uses the repository's PR template if one exists

evals.prompt: Use pr-describe to rewrite PR #17. Its body has the repo's checklist filled in, two screenshots, and 'Fixes #12' at the bottom, but the summary paragraph is one line of jargon.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites the summary in plain language while keeping the checklist, the screenshots, and the closing keyword.
expectations: The new body still contains the filled-in checklist
The screenshots remain in the body
'Fixes #12' remains so the issue still auto-closes
Any acronym or codename in the old summary is expanded or glossed
Reports which parts of the old body were kept and which were dropped

evals.prompt: Review PR #12 for bugs and security issues.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke pr-describe; this is a defect review, which is pr-smellz territory.
expectations: Does not run pr_context.sh or edit the PR body
Routes to pr-smellz or reviews directly

evals.prompt: Write the release notes for v2.3 from the merged PRs.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke pr-describe; release notes are a different artifact with a different audience.
expectations: Does not edit any PR body
Produces release notes directly or asks for the PR range
